To determine how long it will take Bob to dig the hole, we can follow these steps:

1. **Calculate the volume of the hole:** 
   The hole is shaped like a rectangular prism with a length of 6 feet, a width of 4 feet, and a depth of 3 feet. 
   $$\text{Volume} = \text{length} \times \text{width} \times \text{depth}$$
   $$\text{Volume} = 6 \times 4 \times 3 = 72 \text{ cubic feet}$$

2. **Calculate the total time required:** 
   It takes Bob 3 seconds to shovel each cubic foot of earth. To find the total time, we multiply the total volume by the time per cubic foot:
   $$\text{Total time} = 72 \text{ cubic feet} \times 3 \text{ seconds/cubic foot} = 216 \text{ seconds}$$
